subject: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Dawson <claire@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan

Team — quick handoff so CS can take the lead on activation. TL;DR: Aurora signed on 2026-07-30 for an annual contract (~$480k ARR). They want a production pilot and first release by 2026-09-30. Key constraints: SAML SSO, VPC peering to their cloud, EU data residency for backups, and SOC 2 evidence required before go-live.

What sales already delivered (attachments): SOW v2 (final with tracked edits), security QA responses. Procurement expects a DocuSign route (link below).

Primary contacts:
- Claire Dawson — Head of Product (day-to-day) — claire@aurorahealth.com
- Marcus Reed — Dev Lead (technical POC) — marcus.reed@aurorahealth.com
- procurement@aurorahealth.com — procurement/legal lead

Open/risks to highlight for CS:
- Timeline is tight: 8 weeks to scheduled go-live. Need alignment on staging availability and test accounts this week.
- They require dedicated throughput for real-time transcription pipelines — recommend Dedicated pool.
- Security: they flagged a redline on data retention clause (their legal is pushing EU-only backup location).

Suggested immediate actions (sales -> CS):
1) Kickoff meeting: next-week window (Mon/Tue preferred by Aurora).
2) Provision a staging Dedicated slot and a test API key (expiry 30d).
3) Share SOC 2/penetration report and confirm what further evidence procurement needs.
4) Assign a PM/CS owner for weekly status until go-live.

Attachments: Aurora_SOW_v2.docx, Aurora_Security_QA_Answers.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/1043
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/aurora/rdw-1043

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Dawson <claire@aurorahealth.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan

Thanks for the summary, Sean — and congrats to the team. Monica here (CS lead). Quick notes and next steps from our side:

1) I'll be the engagement lead and will run the kickoff cadence. Tessa will be primary PM for implementation.
2) Tessa, can you take ownership of the staging/Dedicated provisioning and confirm ETA? We need a test API key and a staging tenant by EOD Friday (2026-08-06) to meet their internal test window.
3) Claire/procurement: we'll surface SOC 2 and the pen test PDF (attached) but we need to know specifically which sections of the SOW their legal wants redlined. If procurement can drop annotated redlines into DocuSign or email, we can triage.
4) Karthik — we'll likely need infra-side input on Dedicated sizing (token rates, concurrency) and whether we should reserve a slot in us-west to reduce latency.

Initial proposed kickoff agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (5)
- Implementation milestones & acceptance criteria (10)
- Integration checklist (SSO, VPC, data flows) (10)
- Security/Compliance deliverables & procurement path (5)
- Next steps & owners (5)

I will block a tentative slot for Mon 2026-08-10 at 10am PT unless Aurora proposes otherwise.

Tessa — quick ack and ETA please.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan

Ack — taking PM lead. Action items I'm starting now:
- Provisioning request to infra for a temporary Dedicated pool (estimate: 2 x A40-equivalent slots, will follow up with sizing numbers).
- Create test tenant + API key (will email creds to Claire & Marcus in secure channel).
- Draft 30/60/90 milestone tracker and share by EOD Thu (2026-08-06).

Hold for Karthik on infra sizing; will not finalize commitment until we have token profile from Marcus.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Implementation PM | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dawson <claire@aurorahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan

Thanks, Monica/Tessa — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from Aurora: 

- Marcus will provide a sample token/profile by EOD Thu (2026-08-06) so you can size the Dedicated slot.
- Procurement: we will route the SOW through DocuSign today with a single annotated redline (data retention backup location) — link will come from procurement@aurorahealth.com.
- Kickoff: Mon 2026-08-10 10am PT works for us. Marcus and I will join; procurement may attend the first 15 minutes.

I also attached Marcus's architecture note (pasted below) — short version: we need low-jitter <100ms p99 for live streams; prefer us-west nodes and a VPC peering route for PII data ingestion.

On Marcus's note: "We'll send a small sample workload (500 concurrent, 256 token avg) to validate throughput. We expect a staging run to match production SLA before signoff."

We look forward to the kickoff. I'll post the DocuSign link when procurement sends it.

—Claire
Claire Dawson
Head of Product | Aurora Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Dawson <claire@aurorahealth.com>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Onboarding: Executive Compact & Mutual Action Plan

Adding infra/implementation perspective:

- Dedicated recommendation: start with a 2-slot Dedicated pool in us-west (A100- or A40-class) with automatic burst to shared if we need headroom. Estimated baseline cost: ~$11k–14k/mo; will confirm with infra once we have the sample workload.
- Staging: we can provision a mirror staging tenant in us-west and seed it with synthetic traffic for a pre-signoff run; need the workload sample Marcus mentioned.
- SSO: we support SAML IdP; please collect SP metadata from Aurora and send to infra for SSO setup.
- Data residency: backups to EU-only is possible but requires documented runbook; legal and compliance will need to approve the final SOW language.

Immediate asks for Aurora (to close this sprint):
1) Marcus to send workload sample + token profile (500 concurrent, 256 avg tokens as noted).
2) Procurement to upload annotated SOW redlines or DocuSign envelope.
3) Claire to confirm whether backups must be EU-only at go-live or only for historical archives.

I'll open an infra ticket for Dedicated provisioning once Tessa confirms the sizing.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
